model: IMD+ERA5 XGBoost Rapid Intensification (runtime fusion model)
inference_flow: build_imd_fusion_features: 9 IMD predictors (wind_minus_Lh_kt == wind(t-L); delta_v_minus_Lh_kt == wind(t)-wind(t-L))
build_era5_static_features: 38 static ERA5 predictors from environmental_features base fields
build_era5_temporal_features: 51 capped-lag temporal deltas when in-storm ERA5 history available, else NaN
98-feature vector in booster.feature_names order (validated at load)

missing_data_policy.imd: NaN preserved for missing trend fields; XGBoost native missing handling
missing_data_policy.era5_temporal: NaN when no prior in-storm ERA5 observation within the capped lag; never zero-filled
missing_data_policy.no_fabrication: if ERA5 base fields absent at runtime, fusion is NOT run; the adapter falls back to IMD-only and labels it as such

fallback_policy.era5_unavailable: use documented IMD-only fallback, clearly labelled; fusion_probability=None
